people.name: Moab
people.line: Ancient kingdom east of the Dead Sea in Jordan

translations.web: Moreover I will cause to cease in Moab,” says Yahweh, “him who offers in the high place, and him who burns incense to his gods.
translations.bsb: In Moab, declares the LORD, I will bring an end to those who make offerings on the high places and burn incense to their gods.
translations.kjv: Moreover I will cause to cease in Moab, saith the LORD, him that offereth in the high places, and him that burneth incense to his gods.
translations.asv: Moreover I will cause to cease in Moab, saith Jehovah, him that offereth in the high place, and him that burneth incense to his gods.
